items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with a walk of 10 to 19 minutes getting most of the gain. You walked after 2 of your scored meals, which is too few to measure your own effect yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a rise in sugar, with dinners at 8-9 pm linked to a 13.3 mg/dL more rise in sugar than dinners before 6 pm. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Having an overnight fast of 12.7 hours, with 46.7% of nights reaching 13 hours, is part of your routine. In a program, adding an overnight fast to coaching changed some numbers, but it's not clear how it affects sugar levels yet.
